(1) we propose an approach for the classification of unclear questions in community question answering websites, which is based on the idea of similar questions, (2) we construct a novel dataset of unclear questions and (3) we compare our approach against several state of the art baselines.

(a) a question classification approach based on the notion that similar questions are likely to have the same clarity level, outperforms the baselines, (b) the performance of this approach can be further improved by the use of question similarity measures and (c) the performance is further improved by the inclusion of a question’s context, which is represented by the question’s tags.
